result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of it has been run.

- **API** (`features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`): sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. On success it refetches the comments list and shows a "Comment Updated" notification.
- **Notification placement:** I put the notification in the mutation hook, as `features/CLAUDE.md` requires. The existing comment and discussion components still add their notifications themselves. I left those alone.
- **UI** (`features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`): an "Edit Comment" button opens a form drawer with the body prefilled.
- **Comments list** (`comments-list.tsx`): the Edit button only appears when `comment.author?.id` matches the current user's id. Admins don't get it on other people's comments, though they can still delete them.
- **Mock API** (`testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts`): I added a PATCH handler that only updates a comment if the caller is its author, and returns 404 otherwise.
